name: remnote-atkinson-hyperlegible
description: RemNote plugin to apply the Atkinson Hyperlegible Next font for easier reading
author: Burbank

scripts.build: shx rm -rf dist && shx mkdir -p dist && shx cp -r public/* dist/ && shx cp -r fonts dist/ && shx cp src/snippet.css dist/ && shx cp README.md dist/ && shx cp FONT_LICENSE.txt dist/ && cd dist && bestzip ../PluginZip.zip ./*
